name: Original Wellspring Cave entry approach, save before activation

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local waypoints={{util.vector3(68480,47872,800.0),util.vector3(67968,48512,800.0),util.vector3(67840,49280,816.0),util.vector3(67456,50048,824.0),util.vector3(67200,50816,840.0),util.vector3(67072,51584,840.0),util.vector3(66944,52480,912.0),util.vector3(66688,53248,952.0),util.vector3(66432,54016,968.0),util.vector3(66048,54784,1008.0),util.vector3(65536,55552,1024.0),util.vector3(64896,56192,952.0),util.vector3(64256,56832,952.0),util.vector3(64000,57600,928.0),util.vector3(64000,58496,776.0),util.vector3(64000,59392,720.0),util.vector3(64256,60032,496.0),util.vector3(64485.90625,60088.42578125,562.1966552734375)}}
local stage=1;local path=nil;local index=1;local timer=0;local age=0
local arrived=false;local attempts=0;local stuck=0;local best=math.huge;local cooldown=0
local function distance(a,b) local v=a-b;return math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y) end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;age=age+dt;if timer<.1 then return end
 local elapsed=timer;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during genuine Cairn Bolete approach')
 if core.isWorldPaused() or age<3 then return end
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x53fe0))
 local destination=waypoints[stage]
 while stage<#waypoints and distance(destination,self.position)<180 do
  stage=stage+1;destination=waypoints[stage];path=nil;attempts=0;stuck=0;best=math.huge
  print('CairnRoute stage='..stage)
 end
 if arrived or (stage==#waypoints and target and target:isValid() and (target.position-camera.getPosition()):length()<147) then
  arrived=true;print('CairnRoute aim x=0 y=0');print('CairnRoute input=turn')
  assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original Cairn Bolete missing at arrival')
  print('CairnRoute arrived original=053fe0 pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6251e)))
  local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target.position)
  local yaw=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z);local pitch=-math.atan2(v.y,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z))
  if math.abs(yaw)<.025 and math.abs(pitch)<.025 then print('CairnRoute facing destination') end
  print(string.format('CairnRoute look x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
  return
 end
  if stage==#waypoints and target and target:isValid() and distance(destination,self.position)<110 then
  local eye=camera.getPosition();local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(util.vector3(target.position.x,target.position.y,eye.z));local angle=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
  print(string.format('CairnRoute aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5)))))
  if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('CairnRoute facing') end
  print('CairnRoute input='..(math.abs(angle)>.2 and 'turn' or 'continue'));return
 end
 if not path and (self.position.z<0 or destination.z<0) then path={{destination}};index=1;stuck=0;best=math.huge;print('CairnRoute ordinary swim stage='..stage) end
 if not path then
  print('CairnRoute aim x=0 y=0');print('CairnRoute input=wait')
 cooldown=cooldown-elapsed;if cooldown>0 then return end;cooldown=1
  local status,p=nearby.findPath(self.position,destination,{{agentBounds=Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),destinationTolerance=60}})
  attempts=attempts+1;
  if attempts>=4 and stage<#waypoints then print('CairnRoute skip unreachable intermediate stage='..stage);stage=stage+1;attempts=0;path=nil;best=math.huge;stuck=0;return end
  assert(attempts<15,'Runtime navigation repeatedly failed at original Cairn stage='..stage)
  print('CairnRoute query stage='..stage..' status='..tostring(status)..' points='..#p..' end='..tostring(p[#p]))
  if #p>1 and distance(p[#p],self.position)>60 then path=p;index=1;stuck=0;best=math.huge end
  return
 end
 while index<=#path and distance(path[index],self.position)<55 do index=index+1;best=math.huge;stuck=0 end
 if index>#path then path=nil;return end
 local remaining=distance(path[index],self.position)
 if remaining<best-3 then best=remaining;stuck=0 elseif self.controls.movement>0 then stuck=stuck+elapsed else stuck=0 end
 if stuck>10 then path=nil;return end
 local eye=camera.getPosition();local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(util.vector3(path[index].x,path[index].y,eye.z));local angle=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
 print(string.format('CairnRoute aim x=%d y=%d stage=%d point=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5))),stage,index,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,distance(destination,self.position)))
 if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('CairnRoute facing') end
 print('CairnRoute input='..(math.abs(angle)>.2 and 'turn' or (stuck>2 and 'jump' or 'continue')))
end}}}}
